q: SELECT p.id, p.arxiv_id, p.pub_date, p.created_at, s.ai_relevance, s.domain_relevance, o.paper_id IS NOT NULL AS has_output, o.tldr_zh IS NOT NULL AND o.tldr_zh<>'' AS has_tldr, o.title_zh IS NOT NULL AND o.title_zh<>'' AS has_title_zh FROM papers p LEFT JOIN paper_scores s ON s.paper_id=p.id LEFT JOIN llm_outputs o ON o.paper_id=p.id WHERE p.id IN (53665,53662,53659,32160,32073) ORDER BY p.id DESC;
